about: Close economics per segment and epoch range, oldest first (1.26.257). Each range applies from its from_epoch close until the next range. Keys: estab_ttl (closes an Agent stays established without a new challenge_eligible close), intake_floor and intake_rate (the door: max(floor, ceil(rate x established set)) newly eligible Agents per close), waitlist_epochs (closes an eligible Agent that was not admitted keeps its place; 0 means none), settle_cap (oldest pending rows a close evaluates; null means no cap) and carry_cap_pools (unallocated emission carried into the next close, in pools; 0 means it burns). The newest range of the current segment is overlaid with /api/params when it carries the matching key. History stays on the rule each close ran under.

1.source: /api/params during Segment 1 (estab_ttl 6, settle_cap_per_close 2000); intake max(5, ceil(10%)) from LabLeak post 1582 and comment 6193
